title: cs-daily-scratchpad-priya-natarajan-2026-03-18
content:
Daily CS scratchpad - Priya N. (2026-03-18)

Morning triage (quick hits)
- 09:15: follow-up w/ Jamie re: GreenLeaf PO status (AE owning). AE said awaiting legal sign-off. Need escalation if not signed by 2026-03-24.
- 10:00: internal sync w/ Solutions (Ethan) re: Nimbus QBR deck. Confirm latest usage slides.
- Tickets to check: INC-4521 (slow inference on dedicated pool - Atlas Retail), INC-4599 (embedding mismatch - Helios Bank).

Priority items (today)
[ ] Nimbus Analytics QBR prep (meeting 2026-03-25 11:00 PST) - high priority
    - Owner: Priya + Jamie (slides) + Solutions (Ethan) for technical appendix
    - Needs: updated 90-day usage+cost chart, top 5 feature adoption stories, outstanding NPS/CSAT snippets, ask: executive sponsor (CTO) to attend
    - Action: pull usage export from Console (per-route token/time bins) --> request run by infra (ticket CONFLUENCE-CCG-2031)
    - Draft slide outline: 1) Exec summary + outcomes, 2) Usage & cost trends, 3) Performance wins (latency, error rate), 4) Adoption stories, 5) Roadmap & asks

[ ] GreenLeaf Health renewal (term ends 2026-04-30) - medium
    - Current ARR: $120k/yr (HS-DEAL-452)
    - Open items: PO, SSO cert for Analytics dashboard, data privacy addendum signed
    - Owner: Jamie Park (AE) - check in midday for PO ETA
    - If PO not in by 2026-03-24 escalate to Director of Sales (Karen)

[ ] Atlas Retail support follow-up (INC-4521) - high
    - Symptom: occasional 5-8s tail latency on dedicated pool during peak (04:00-06:00 UTC)
    - Engineering contact: Marco (serving-runtime) assigned to reproduce; need logs from 2026-03-12 -> 2026-03-16 window
    - Action: ping Marco + attach customer repro steps + ask for proposed temporary mitigation (increase pool or fallback policy)

Support & ops notes
- Helios Bank embedding mismatch (ticket INC-4599) - root cause likely model aliasing after rollout. Confirmed that fallback to prior model returns expected vectors. Next: schedule canary config to prevent automatic alias switch during business hours. Owner: Ethan.
- Observability: ask observability team to add token-level cost breakdown slide for Nimbus QBR (show 2% of top 10 routes -> 60% of cost).

Tomorrow/this week
- Prep: finalize Nimbus deck (target: 2026-03-23 17:00 PST for internal review)
- Run renewal playbook for GreenLeaf: check redlines on DPA, confirm SSO testing window (2026-04-05 -> 2026-04-09)
- Schedule 30m touchpoint w/ Atlas technical lead post-mitigation (aim for 2026-03-20)

Quick reminders / miscellany
- Share QBR invite template with Jamie (confluence: CONFLUENCE-CCG-2031)
- Log notes in HubSpot after every customer contact (HS-DEAL-452 for GreenLeaf)
- Add outcome metric to QBR slides: "% reduction in per-token cost vs baseline" (use Optimize recommendations)

Notes to self
- Keep QBR deck punchy - customers hate >20 slides. Exec summary slide first with 3 bullets: wins, risks, asks.
- When escalating, include exact PO/contract clause and a clear ask (escalate to legal or AE?).

End of day checklist
[ ] Update tickets with progress and next steps
[ ] Send Nimbus internal review calendar invite (target 2026-03-23 17:00 PST)
[ ] Quick sync with Jamie re: GreenLeaf PO status (EOD)

Last updated: 2026-03-18 08:45 PST - Priya N.
